entry.title: Market brief — 20 Nov 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Friday, 20 November 2026 the Sensex closed at 83,919.71 (+897.96, +1.08%) and the Nifty 50 at 25,800.60 (+286.30, +1.12%), led by bank stocks, while the rupee settled 65 paise stronger at 92.67 per dollar. IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at ₹1,23,584 per 10 g (-4.92%) and 999 silver at ₹1,50,650 per kg (-6.76%). The exchanges are shut on Saturday 21 November 2026, so this is the last session's close; the next session is Monday, 23 November 2026.
